headline: Ecotourism Tour Guide
summary: Ecotourism tour guide with three years leading nature and farm tours in Cebu's highlands and mangroves. I explain local ecology, history and farming to visitors, work with communities on tree planting and conservation, and make sure every tour leaves the site better than we found it.

experience.title: Ecotourism Tour Guide
bullets: Lead nature walks, mangrove boat tours and farm visits for about 30 groups a month.
Explain the ecology, history and livelihoods of each site in English, Filipino and Cebuano.
Organise tree-planting activities for school and company groups with partner communities.
Brief visitors on leave-no-trace rules and collect feedback after each tour.

experience.title: Community Tourism Volunteer
bullets: Guided visitors through coffee and vegetable farms and explained organic practices.
Helped farmers welcome visitors and sell their produce.

education.credential: Bachelor of Science in Tourism Management
